into A2FDirect3.bin, converted to FP16):

Licensed by NVIDIA Corporation under the NVIDIA Open Model License
See licenses/NVIDIA-Open-Model-License.txt and https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Audio2Face-3D-v2.3-Mark

DBReV_API.h: public integration header supplied with Dragonborn ReVoiced 1.4.4+.
Its author permits use, modification and redistribution, including in closed-source projects.
The original notice is retained in include/a2f/speech/DBReV_API.h.

emotion_fp16.onnx (NVIDIA Audio2Emotion v2.2, converted to FP16):
Licensed by NVIDIA Corporation under the NVIDIA Open Model License
The attribution above is required by section 3.1 of the License Agreement for NVIDIA Audio2Emotion Model for Use with
Audio2Face Project. That specific agreement governs this model, including its use restrictions.
See licenses/NVIDIA-Audio2Emotion-License.txt and https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Audio2Emotion-v2.2
The model may only be used with the NVIDIA Audio2Face project, and not for the purpose of emotion recognition.

emotion_performance.onnx (modified model distilled from NVIDIA Audio2Emotion v2.2

Only for use with the NVIDIA Audio2Face project, not for emotion recognition.
